dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I never realized Genius Invokation was so popular... Maybe I should roll out a whole line of card-themed cakes? One cake for every set of cards...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Leaving already? I'm gonna pick up some supplies before I go. What supplies, you ask? New cards! Some of them have excellent artwork.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: That was a great match! Oh, I almost forgot. I got another order for a custom Genius Invokation cake recently, but I don't have a copy of the card he wants. If you have it, mind if I use it for reference?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I lost... Looks like I need more practice. The other chefs, maybe? No, that's no good, I can't distract them...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: You wanna play cards? Sure! I think I... know the basics, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Piece of cake! Looks like reviewing those demo matches before paid off.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Well, watching replays alone clearly isn't enough... I don't know how to whip up a response to unorthodox moves.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I once researched this game to help fulfill a custom order... Not sure how much I learned, but the customer was happy with their cake.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Looks like all that practice wasn't a waste. Why was I practicing? For cake-baking, obviously.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: *cough* Seems my performance was... somewhat lacking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
